<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="选择接入工具"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#选择接入工具">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">选择接入工具</span></h2>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="准备账号与-api-key"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#准备账号与-api-key">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">准备账号与 API Key</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">在开始配置前，请先确认账号已具备可用的 Step Plan，并准备好 Step API Key。它们分别决定您是否可以正常开通调用能力，以及后续请求的身份认证与授权。</span>
<blockquote>
<span data-as="p">建议顺序：先确认已订阅或开通 Step Plan，再创建 API Key，最后接入具体工具。</span>
</blockquote>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="订阅-step-plan"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#订阅-step-plan">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">订阅 Step Plan</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">如果您是首次使用开放平台，建议先检查当前账号是否已经完成 Step Plan 订阅或开通。通常情况下，只有在具备可用套餐、计划或对应调用权限后，后续的模型调用、额度消耗和能力使用才会正常生效。</span>
<span data-as="p">如果您的账号已经由团队统一开通，可直接进入下一步；如果尚未开通，请前往 <a class="link" href="https://platform.stepfun.com/step-plan" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">Step Plan 订阅</a> 完成对应计划的订阅，再继续创建 API Key 和接入第三方工具。</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="获取-api-key"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#获取-api-key">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">获取 API Key</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">获取方式：</span>
<ul>
<li><a class="link" href="https://platform.stepfun.com/interface-key" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">Step 开放平台</a></li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">建议您在控制台创建一个新的 API Key，并妥善保存，不要直接写入代码仓库。</span>
<span data-as="p">首次接入时，推荐优先使用以下模型完成验证：</span>
<div class="code-block mt-5 mb-8 not-prose rounded-2xl relative group min-w-0 print:print-color-exact text-gray-950 dark:text-gray-50 codeblock-light border border-gray-950/10 dark:border-white/10 <span class="line"><span></span></span></code></pre></div></div></div></div><div aria-hidden="true" class="code-block-fade-overlay print:hidden" data-fade-overlay="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div>
<span data-as="p">在不同工具中，您会频繁看到这些配置项：</span>
<ul>
<li><code>API Provider</code>：选择接口提供方式，例如 <code>OpenAI Compatible</code></li>
<li><code>Base URL</code>：按工具使用的协议选择模型服务地址。Chat Completions API（OpenAI 兼容）/ OpenAI Compatible 工具填写 <code>https://api.stepfun.com/step_plan/v1</code>；Messages API（Anthropic 兼容）工具填写 <code>https://api.stepfun.com/step_plan</code></li>
<li><code>API Key</code>：在 Step 平台获取的密钥</li>
<li><code>Model</code> 或 <code>Model ID</code>：填写 <code>step-3.7-flash</code></li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<span data-as="p">注意：Claude Code 手动编辑配置文件时，<code>ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL</code> 应填写 Messages API（Anthropic 兼容）对应的 <code>https://api.stepfun.com/step_plan</code>（不带 <code>/v1</code>）。Claude Code 会在调用时自动拼接 <code>/v1/messages</code>。</span>
</blockquote>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="常见检查项"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#常见检查项">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">常见检查项</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">如果调用失败，优先检查以下几项：</span>
<ul>
<li>API Key 是否填写正确且属于正确环境</li>
<li><code>Base URL</code> 是否与工具协议匹配：Chat Completions API（OpenAI 兼容）/ OpenAI Compatible 使用 <code>https://api.stepfun.com/step_plan/v1</code>，Messages API（Anthropic 兼容）/ Claude Code 配置文件使用 <code>https://api.stepfun.com/step_plan</code></li>
<li><code>Model</code> 或 <code>Model ID</code> 是否填写为 <code>step-3.7-flash</code></li>
